title: Fiesta Tofu Burrito Bowls
subtitle: with Black Beans and Avocado
description: Whether you’re full-time vego or part-time only, our varied range of vegetarian dishes really hits the spot. Bursting with veggies, dairy, legumes, grains and nuts, they’re packed with flavour, they’ll fill you up and they’re totally mouth-watering too!

steps.text: Cook rice: Check your avocado is ripe before starting this recipe (see Cooking tip). Rinse the rice until the water runs clear. Put in a small saucepan with 250ml (1 cup) water, cover and bring to a simmer over medium heat. Reduce the heat to low and cook for 12 mins or until tender and the water is absorbed. Turn off the heat and stand, covered, for at least 5 mins. Fluff the rice with a fork.
Marinate tofu: Meanwhile, cut the tofu into 3cm chunks. Combine 1 tsp Mexican seasoning (see Make it milder), 2 tsp tomato sauce and 1 tsp olive oil in a large bowl. Add the tofu and toss to coat.

Make sauce: Finely chop the coriander, including the stems. Combine 1 tsp coriander, 1 tsp Mexican seasoning, 2 tsp mayonnaise and 2 tsp water in a bowl and season with salt and pepper. Drain and rinse half the beans. Cut the avocado into 2cm chunks.

Warm beans: Heat 1 tsp olive oil in a medium frypan over medium-high heat. Add the beans and cook, stirring, for 1-2 mins until warmed through. Transfer to a bowl, reserving the pan. Add 1 tsp coriander and 1 tsp white wine vinegar to the beans, season with salt and pepper and toss to combine.

Warm tofu and serve up: Heat 2 tsp olive oil in the reserved pan over medium heat. Cook the tofu for 2 mins each side or until golden and warmed through. Divide the rice, beans, avocado and tofu among bowls and drizzle with the sauce. Scatter over the remaining coriander and enjoy!
Make it milder: Our Mexican seasoning has a mild chilli kick. If you aren't keen on too much spice, adjust the amount to taste in the tofu marinade and/or omit it from the sauce.
